label: sprint
definition: One week of work, Monday to Monday, with one sprint goal. On GitHub a sprint is a milestone: its description is the sprint goal and the issues on it are the sprint backlog. Waves run inside a sprint. The cckit sprint verb that opens and closes one is not built yet.
is_not: A wave: a wave is a parallel batch of unblocked issues inside a sprint and ends when its PRs merge; a sprint ends on Monday.
An effort: an effort is one goal that ships as one PR and may finish inside a sprint or span two.
A release: a release ships the base branch to its users; a sprint ends with a review, whether or not a release happened.
